senses.gloss: (v. בְּטַט2) to tread; to kick, knock down (with one’s foot), crush.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 24:10">Targ. Y. I Ex. XXIV, 10</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 116b:2">Sabb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>אתא חמרא וב׳ לשרגא</he> the ass (offered to the judge as a bribe) came and knocked the (gold) lamp over.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 62a:8">B. Kam. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>דב׳ בכספתא וכ׳</he> who kicked the money box aside so that he threw it into the river.
B. Kam. 99ᵃ he hired him לבַטּוּשֵׁי (Rashi a. Ms. R.) for stamping; v. בִּיטְשָׁא.—Transf. to treat with contempt, sneer at.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 14:9">Targ. Y. Num. XIV, 9</cite>.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:1">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> top. *<cite ref="Shevuot 30b:7">Shebu. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>בטש ביה ואוקמיה לע״ה</he> (Ms. F. only … <he>אוקמיה</he>) he insulted the ignorant man and made him stand up; v., however, <cite ref="B01397"><he>בְּתַשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 24:10">Targ. Y. I Ex. XXIV, 10</cite>.
